scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @cubers/api && npm run build -w @cubers/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:load: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @cubers/api && tsx scripts/load-test.ts
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @cubers/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @cubers/mobile
scripts.test:docker: npm run build:core && node --import tsx scripts/docker-smoke.ts
